title: Vichoriyaan Di Satai Hay Teri Bhain Akbar
body:
Vihoriyaan di stai hay teri bhain akbar
Aaa teri rah chay payi kerdi ro k wain akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Guzerda din tere qadmaa dayan nishana tay
Udeek mukdi meri shaam nu azana tay
Nai Tere veer nay aanna hawawaan kain akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu Naal babay day kaira mulk wasaya Ay
Bimaar bhain day sir tay hay kisda saya Ay
Nai honda rog judai da Methoon sain akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Jina day veer na pardais jaa k nai anday
Kaday vi ujriyan bhaina nu chain nai anday
Tu ghaliya khat naa hi mainu naa Ayoon lain akbar
